审题.题型: 应用文（建议书）：为学校的新生入学教育活动写一份建议书
任务: 写一个标题，点明这是一份关于新生入学教育活动的建议书
写出活动的目的（aim）：帮助新生适应新环境和大学学习
写出活动的时长（duration）：什么时候开始、持续多久
写出参与者（participants）：谁组织、谁参加、还请谁来
写出活动内容（activities）：按时间顺序列出几项具体安排，最后表达信心、礼貌收尾
审题.语气: 正式、清楚、有条理：建议书写的是还没举办的活动，通篇用一般将来时 will 描述安排；语气积极、肯定，像一份可以直接执行的计划
审题.字数: 120—180 词（题目要求 at least 120 words but no more than 180 words）；标题不计入字数，本篇正文 177 词。写到 160—180 词最稳，绝不能超过 180 词
易错: 标题写在正文上方，实词首字母大写：A Proposal for a Freshman Orientation Program，句末不加句号
题目列出的 aim、duration、participants、activities 四项，每一项都要在文中找得到，漏掉一项就是没有完全切题
活动还没举办，描述安排要用一般将来时 will，不要写成过去时（写报告才用过去时）
活动不要只写 some activities，要写出具体做什么、谁来做，最好按时间顺序（On the first day、Next、Then、Finally）
adapt to 后面接名词：adapt to their new environment，不写 adapt the new environment

要求.原句: A Proposal for a Freshman Orientation Program
要求.说明: 标题用 A Proposal for + 名词短语，点明文体和内容（新生入学教育活动），写在正文上方，不计入字数。

要求.原句: To help freshmen adapt to their new environment and academic studies as quickly as possible
要求.说明: 第一段开头就用 To help … 说出目的，几乎就是题目里的原意，用自己的话写出来，并加上 as quickly as possible。

要求.原句: The program will last one week, starting on the day after registration.
要求.说明: 第二段第一句写清持续多久（一周）和从哪天开始（报到后第二天），开学时间第一段也交代了（at the start of the coming semester）。

要求.原句: It will be organized by the Student Affairs Office with the help of student volunteers, and all freshmen are expected to take part.
要求.说明: 组织者（学生事务处和学生志愿者）、参加者（全体新生）写在一句里，下一句再补上受邀的老师和高年级学生，参与者交代得很完整。

要求.原句: The program will include a variety of activities.
要求.说明: 第三段先总起，再按时间顺序列出四项：参观校园、老师介绍课程和学习方法、学长学姐分享经验、欢迎会。每项都写清做什么，大多还用 to do、so that 说出为什么。

要求.原句: teachers will hold meetings to introduce the curriculum, credit requirements and effective study methods
要求.说明: 题目说的是适应“新环境”和“大学学习”两方面：参观校园、欢迎会对应新环境，老师讲课程和学习方法对应学习，学长学姐的经验两方面都管。

要求.原句: I am confident that this program will help freshmen settle in smoothly and get off to a good start in college.
要求.说明: 最后一段用 I am confident that … 说出预期效果，回扣第一段的目的，首尾呼应。

要求.原句: The program will include a variety of activities.
要求.说明: 正文共 177 词（标题不计）：目的 1 句，时长和参与者 3 句，活动 5 句，结尾 1 句，题目的四项要求篇幅都照顾到了，没有超过 180 词。

思路.内容: A Proposal for a Freshman Orientation Program（关于新生入学教育活动的建议），写在正文上方
为了帮助新生尽快适应新环境和大学学习 → 建议在下学期开学时举办入学教育活动
为期一周，报到后第二天开始 → 学生事务处组织、学生志愿者协助，全体新生参加 → 各院系老师和高年级学生受邀参加
总起：多种多样的活动 → 第一天参观校园，熟悉图书馆、实验室、食堂、医务室 → 老师介绍课程、学分要求和学习方法 → 高年级学生分享经验、分组答疑 → 欢迎会结交新朋友
相信这项活动能帮助新生顺利适应，在大学开个好头

步骤.做法: 用 A Proposal for a Freshman Orientation Program，freshman 在这里作定语用单数，实词首字母大写，写在正文上方。

步骤.标题: 第一句同时写出目的和建议
步骤.做法: 用 To help freshmen adapt to … as quickly as possible 开头说目的（aim），主句 I would like to propose an orientation program 提出建议，句末 at the start of the coming semester 交代时间。
用 The program will last one week 写持续多久，再用现在分词短语 starting on the day after registration 补充从哪天开始，一句话写清 duration。
用被动语态 It will be organized by … with the help of … 写组织者，用 all freshmen are expected to take part 写参加者；下一句用 will also be invited 补上受邀的老师和高年级学生。

步骤.标题: 总起活动，按时间顺序列出
步骤.做法: 先用 The program will include a variety of activities. 总起；再用 On the first day、Next、Then、Finally 按时间顺序写四项活动，参观校园、老师讲解、欢迎会分别用 to do 或 so that 说明目的。
用 I am confident that this program will help freshmen … 收尾，settle in smoothly 和 get off to a good start 回扣第一段的“尽快适应”。

句式.名称: To help … I would like to propose 目的建议句
句式.表达: 表达“为了帮助……，我想建议举办……”，在建议书开头一句话说出目的和建议
句式.公式: To help + 人 + 动词原形 … (as quickly as possible), I would like to propose + 名词 + 时间
句式.原句: To help freshmen adapt to their new environment and academic studies as quickly as possible, I would like to propose an orientation program at the start of the coming semester
句式.原句译: 为了帮助新生尽快适应新环境和大学学习，我想建议在下学期开学时举办一次入学教育活动
句式.讲解: 不定式 To help … 放句首表示目的，读者第一眼就知道“为什么要办”；help 后面直接接动词原形 adapt；adapt to 意思是“适应”，后接名词。主句 I would like to propose 后面直接接名词（an orientation program）。目的、建议、时间一句写完，开头干净利落。

例句.en: To help students relax before exams, I would like to propose a music night at the end of this month.
例句.zh: 为了帮助同学们考前放松，我想建议在本月底举办一场音乐晚会。

例句.en: To help international students learn about Chinese culture, I would like to propose a culture week next term.
例句.zh: 为了帮助留学生了解中国文化，我想建议下学期举办一个文化周。

替换.en: In order to …, I suggest that we …
The aim of the program is to …

句式.名称: will last …, starting on 时长句
句式.表达: 表达“活动将持续多久，从某天开始”，交代活动的时间安排
句式.公式: The program / event + will last + 时长, starting on / in + 时间
句式.原句: The program will last one week, starting on the day after registration
句式.原句译: 活动为期一周，从报到后的第二天开始
句式.讲解: last 在这里是动词“持续”，后面直接接时长，不加 for 也可以；starting on … 是现在分词短语，补充开始的时间，比再写一句 It will start on … 更紧凑。the day after registration 意思是“报到后的第二天”。

例句.en: The book fair will last three days, starting on the first Monday of May.
例句.zh: 书市将持续三天，从五月的第一个星期一开始。

例句.en: The training course will last two weeks, starting on the day after the final exam.
例句.zh: 培训课程将持续两周，从期末考试后的第二天开始。

替换.en: The program will run from … to …

句式.名称: be organized by … with the help of 组织者句
句式.表达: 表达“活动将由……在……的协助下组织，……都要参加”，交代组织者和参与者
句式.公式: It will be organized by + 组织者 + with the help of + 协助者, and all + 人 + are expected to take part
句式.原句: It will be organized by the Student Affairs Office with the help of student volunteers, and all freshmen are expected to take part
句式.原句译: 活动将由学生事务处在学生志愿者的协助下组织，全体新生都要参加
句式.讲解: 被动语态 will be organized by 突出“活动由谁组织”；with the help of 补充协助者；and 后面的 are expected to take part 意思是“应当参加”，比 must take part 委婉。一句话里组织者、协助者、参加者全写到了，题目的 participants 一次落实。

例句.en: The sports meeting will be organized by the student union with the help of PE teachers, and all classes are expected to take part.
例句.zh: 运动会将由学生会在体育老师的协助下组织，各班都要参加。

例句.en: The tree-planting day will be organized by the Youth League with the help of local volunteers, and all first-year students are expected to join.
例句.zh: 植树日将由团委在当地志愿者的协助下组织，全体一年级学生都要参加。

替换.en: The program is open to all …

句式.名称: take a guided tour … to become familiar with 目的活动句
句式.表达: 表达“在引导下参观……，以便熟悉……”，写一项活动并说出它的目的
句式.公式: 主语 + will take a guided tour of + 地方 + to become familiar with + A, B, C and D
句式.原句: freshmen will take a guided tour of the campus to become familiar with the library, laboratories, canteens and the medical center
句式.原句译: 新生将在引导下参观校园，熟悉图书馆、实验室、食堂和医务室
句式.讲解: take a guided tour of 意思是“在引导下参观”；后面的不定式 to become familiar with 说出参观的目的；列出四个具体地点，活动一下子就具体了。be / become familiar with 意思是“熟悉”，是四级常用短语。

例句.en: Visitors will take a guided tour of the museum to become familiar with the history of the city.
例句.zh: 参观者将在讲解员带领下参观博物馆，了解这座城市的历史。

例句.en: New members will take a guided tour of the club to become familiar with its rules and equipment.
例句.zh: 新会员将在引导下参观俱乐部，熟悉它的规章和器材。

句式.名称: share tips on doing 经验分享句
句式.表达: 表达“分享做某事的诀窍，并回答问题”，写一项交流类活动
句式.公式: 主语 + will share tips on + 动名词 … and answer questions in small groups
句式.原句: senior students will share tips on balancing study and social life and answer questions in small groups
句式.原句译: 高年级学生会分享兼顾学习和社交生活的诀窍，并分小组回答问题
句式.讲解: share tips on 后面接动名词（balancing），意思是“分享做某事的诀窍”；balance study and social life 意思是“兼顾学习和社交”，正是新生最关心的问题；and answer questions in small groups 写出活动形式。两个动词并列，交流活动写得很生动。

例句.en: Graduates will share tips on preparing for job interviews and answer questions in small groups.
例句.zh: 毕业生将分享准备求职面试的诀窍，并分小组回答问题。

例句.en: Top students will share tips on improving English listening and answer questions from younger students.
例句.zh: 优秀学生将分享提高英语听力的诀窍，并回答低年级同学的问题。

替换.en: … will talk about their own experience of …

句式.名称: will be held so that 目的被动句
句式.表达: 表达“将举办……，以便……”，写一项活动及其目的
句式.公式: a / an + 活动 + will be held so that + 主语 + can + 动词原形 …
句式.原句: a welcome party will be held so that freshmen can make new friends
句式.原句译: 将举行一场欢迎会，让新生结交新朋友
句式.讲解: will be held 是被动语态“将被举办”，活动作主语，不用说出谁办；so that 引导目的状语从句，从句里常用 can。前面几项活动用 to do 说目的，这一项换成 so that，句式有变化。

例句.en: A suggestion box will be set up so that students can share their ideas freely.
例句.zh: 将设一个意见箱，让同学们能自由地提出想法。

例句.en: An online group will be created so that parents can keep in touch with teachers.
例句.zh: 将建一个网上群，方便家长和老师保持联系。

替换.en: …, which will give … a chance to …

句式.名称: I am confident that … get off to a good start 信心收尾句
句式.表达: 表达“我相信……会帮助……顺利适应，开个好头”，在建议书结尾说出预期效果
句式.公式: I am confident that + 活动 + will help + 人 + 动词原形 … and get off to a good start in + 名词
句式.原句: I am confident that this program will help freshmen settle in smoothly and get off to a good start in college
句式.原句译: 我相信这项活动将帮助新生顺利适应大学生活，并在大学里开个好头
句式.讲解: I am confident that 意思是“我相信”，比 I think 更肯定、更正式；settle in 意思是“适应新环境、安顿下来”；get off to a good start 意思是“开个好头”，地道又形象。说出效果，正好回扣第一段的目的。

例句.en: I am confident that this training will help new members settle in quickly and get off to a good start.
例句.zh: 我相信这次培训会帮助新成员尽快适应，开个好头。

例句.en: I am confident that the activity will help students relieve stress and enjoy their campus life.
例句.zh: 我相信这项活动会帮助同学们缓解压力，享受校园生活。

替换.en: I hope my proposal will be considered.
替换.zh: 希望我的建议能被考虑。

词汇.义: n. 大学一年级学生；新生
n. 入学教育；（新人的）情况介绍
adj. 熟悉的（become familiar with 熟悉）

词汇.词: get off to a good start

默写.句式: To help … I would like to propose 目的建议句
默写.意义: 建议书开头一句写出目的和建议的模板。

挖空: starting on the day after registration
默写.句式: will last …, starting on 时长句
默写.意义: 写活动时长的万能句，现在分词补充开始时间。

默写.句式: be organized by … with the help of 组织者句
默写.意义: 一句话写清组织者、协助者和参加者。

挖空: take a guided tour of the campus
默写.句式: take a guided tour … to become familiar with 目的活动句
默写.意义: 写活动并说明目的，迎新、参观类题目都能用。

挖空: share tips on balancing study and social life
默写.句式: share tips on doing 经验分享句
默写.意义: 写交流分享类活动的模板。

挖空: so that freshmen can make new friends
默写.句式: will be held so that 目的被动句
默写.意义: 被动语态加 so that，句式有变化。

挖空: get off to a good start
默写.句式: I am confident that … get off to a good start 信心收尾句
默写.意义: 建议书结尾说出预期效果的高分句。

得分.说明: 题目提示的四项内容一项不漏：目的（帮助新生尽快适应新环境和学习）、时长（一周，报到后第二天开始）、参与者（学生事务处组织、志愿者协助、全体新生参加、老师和高年级学生受邀）、活动（参观校园、介绍课程、分享经验、欢迎会）。而且每项活动都对得上目的，结尾回扣目的，内容完整具体，符合满分档“切题、内容充实”的要求。
引用: To help freshmen adapt to their new environment and academic studies as quickly as possible
The program will last one week, starting on the day after registration.
all freshmen are expected to take part
Teachers from each department and senior students will also be invited.
The program will include a variety of activities.
I am confident that this program will help freshmen settle in smoothly

得分.说明: 按题目提示的顺序分段：第一段目的，第二段时长和参与者，第三段活动，第四段收尾，每段各管一件事。活动部分先总起，再用 On the first day、Next、Then、Finally 按时间顺序排列，读者像看日程表一样清楚；It、The program 反复回指活动，also 补充参与者。条理清楚、衔接自然，这是满分档在结构上的表现。
引用: The program will last one week
It will be organized by
will also be invited
The program will include a variety of activities.
On the first day
Next
Then
Finally

得分.说明: 通篇用一般将来时描述还没举办的活动，时态统一准确。句式多样：不定式作目的状语、现在分词短语补充时间、被动语态 will be organized by、will be held so that 目的从句。用词地道准确，如 adapt to、the day after registration、take a guided tour、credit requirements、balancing study and social life、settle in smoothly、get off to a good start。没有语法错误，符合满分档对语言的要求。
引用: as quickly as possible
starting on the day after registration
with the help of student volunteers
take a guided tour of the campus to become familiar with
credit requirements and effective study methods
a welcome party will be held so that freshmen can make new friends
get off to a good start in college

升格.原句: It will be organized by the Student Affairs Office with the help of student volunteers, and all freshmen are expected to take part.

步骤.写法: The school will organize it and all freshmen must join it.
步骤.说明: 参与者写到了，但 the school 太笼统，must 有命令的口气，句子也平淡。

步骤.写法: It will be organized by the Student Affairs Office, and all freshmen are expected to take part.
步骤.说明: 用被动语态突出活动由谁组织，写出具体部门；are expected to take part 比 must join 委婉、正式。

步骤.写法: It will be organized by the Student Affairs Office with the help of volunteers, and all freshmen are expected to take part.
步骤.说明: 加上 with the help of volunteers，参与者更完整；最后写成 student volunteers，说明是学生帮学生，更贴近新生。

升格.原句: On the first day, freshmen will take a guided tour of the campus to become familiar with the library, laboratories, canteens and the medical center.

步骤.写法: First, freshmen will visit the campus.
步骤.说明: 活动有了，但看不出为什么参观、参观哪里。

步骤.写法: On the first day, freshmen will take a guided tour of the campus.
步骤.说明: On the first day 写出时间，和后面的 Next、Then、Finally 组成日程；take a guided tour 写出“有人带着参观”，比 visit 具体。

步骤.写法: On the first day, freshmen will take a guided tour of the campus to become familiar with it.
步骤.说明: 加上 to become familiar with 说出目的；最后把 it 换成 the library, laboratories, canteens and the medical center，列出新生最常去的四个地方，活动就具体可感了。

升格.原句: I am confident that this program will help freshmen settle in smoothly and get off to a good start in college.

步骤.写法: I think this program is very helpful.
步骤.说明: 结尾太普通，helpful 对谁、有什么帮助都没说，也没有回扣目的。

步骤.写法: I am confident that this program will help freshmen adapt to college life.
步骤.说明: I am confident that 比 I think 更肯定；help freshmen adapt to college life 说出效果，回扣第一段。

步骤.写法: I am confident that this program will help freshmen settle in smoothly.
步骤.说明: settle in smoothly（顺利安顿下来）比重复 adapt to 更有变化；最后再补上 and get off to a good start in college，从“适应”上升到“开个好头”，结尾更有分量。

题目译文: 假设你们学校正在组织一个新生入学引导项目（orientation program），帮助新生（freshmen）适应新的环境和大学的学习（adapt to the new environment and academic studies）。
现在请你为这个项目写一份建议书（proposal），内容可以包括（may include）：项目的目的（aim）、时长（duration）、参加人员（participants）和活动安排（activities）。
你有 30 分钟（30 minutes）写这份建议书（proposal）。
字数：至少 120 词（at least 120 words），但不超过 180 词（no more than 180 words）。
